title: The identity scalar model preserves the actual reconstruction unit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme X, a normalized coherent reduction/limit calculus SE, a normalized Roos model rhoE, and a normalized identity scalar model bEE [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. For every ambient derived E-complex K, chi_EE(K) followed by bEE(K) and the total-limit image of the specified whole-system scalar unitor at SE.reduction(K) [lem-trf-quotient-system-mixed-coherence] equals the specified ordinary derived multiplication unitor [lem-pur-completed-line-tensor-coherence] followed by the actual SE adjunction unit at K [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. No completeness or constructibility hypothesis on K is imposed.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10, Proposition 3.5.1 and Lemma 3.5.7; normalization refinement of parent steps 11, using Stacks 0941 whole-system cone counit. This square is an agent expansion, not stated verbatim in the source.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative. coherentPrimitiveReductionPresentation supplies one strict quotient presentation with its actual whole-tower adjunction coherence. Apply the identity scalar-model normalization to that same presentation.

Extend the specified derived scalar-unit representative formula from K-flat complexes to every complex C: resolve C and cancel the localized quasi-isomorphism using naturality of the scalar unit and its universal cochain counit. Hence the inverse system scalar unit followed by the counit equals the localization of inverse ordinary multiplication.

The coherent presentation identifies the actual adjunction unit with the derived constant-tower adjunct of the strict tensor-unit family. Naturality of the scalar unit and exact scalar restriction moves inverse ordinary multiplication into that strict family. Apply integralComparisonRoosTranspose and scalarIdentityRoosAugmentation to compute its entire Roos lift as completedScalarIdentityUnit.

Postcompose the desired equation with the inverse system scalar unit and the scalar-model normalization factor. This factor is invertible because its composite with the realization is the specified comparison isomorphism. The finite-free identity formula and ordinary multiplication unitor normalization make both resulting maps ordinaryUnit followed by the specified chain augmentation. Cancel the factor. Finally use essential surjectivity of the good localization and naturality to transport from the representative to every K.

theorem scalarModelUnit
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (ρE : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E X)
    (bEE : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E) X SE ρE)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) :
    (completedScalarComparison l E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E) X).app K ≫
      bEE.realization.hom.app K ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map
        ((integralComparisonSystemScalarUnit l E X).hom.app (SE.reduction.obj K)) =
    (CompletedLineTensor.ordinaryUnit l E X).hom.app K ≫ SE.adjunction.unit.app K
